items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I told Stretch, I said, come on, you're playing potentates ball tonight, tomorrow, next Friday.

ctx.x: Well, I mean as long as they can be -- if they can solo in an interesting way, it makes sense.

(Unintelligible) he's one of my young (unintelligible). He's -- in '73 -- he worked with Benny Carter -- good tenor man. And he's about -- Stretch is about -- then practically six feet. So I told Stretch, I said, come on, you're playing potentates ball tonight, tomorrow, next Friday. Hi, Hap. I'd say, look, tell you in front, I don't want you to be cutting me on them solos. And that would tickle him to death, you know.
